dedupe_keys.name: gesla high frequency sea level observations

description: The GESLA research consortium assembles worldwide sea-level records with shared formats and quality flags for tides, storm surges and coastal extremes. Its current provider site lists version 4.1 from July 2026, an ERDDAP access service, and archived versions including the article's 2021 version 3. The latter contains 5,119 records and 91,021 station-years at hourly or finer intervals. Public downloads include text observations, CSV metadata and KML locations; the ERDDAP service supports selected subsets. Access is free. Version 3 part 1 is CC-BY-4.0 and part 2 is CC-BY-NC-4.0; provider-specific restrictions and current-version terms require attention. Records differ in duration, datum and quality, so a single global time span does not imply complete coverage. These observations can calibrate coastal-flood and port-operability simulations. They complement local tide-gauge archives while retaining station provenance. No bulk archive was downloaded.
